name: Status lamp beacon post
brief: MK-161 Status lamp beacon post: the base's traffic light for the outside. Round 2, matched to the pick: a framed equipment pedestal with a warm window, a post carrying three caged lanterns (green all's well, amber come back soon, red come inside now), a bell, and a solar cap on top. The game lights one lantern and rings the bell, so the whole base mood is read from the world, not a HUD.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
